Triangle $PQR$ shown is a right triangle. Which of the following has the same value as $P$?
explanation: Choice D is correct. The sine of an acute angle in a right triangle equals the cosine of its complementary angle. In the triangle shown, angle $R$ is a right angle, so angles $P$ and $Q$ are complementary. Therefore, $\cos Q$ has the same value as $\sin P$.
